summary: Erasca, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an underwritten public offering of 31,428,572 shares of common stock at $17.50 per share ($16.45 per share to underwriters), with a 30-day over-allotment option for up to 4,714,285 additional shares. Net proceeds are ~$516 million (~$593.5 million if option exercised). The offering is a routine capital raise under an automatic shelf registration statement (Form S-3), expected to close July 15, 2026. This does not involve a change of control, strategic review, or any special-situation event; it is an ordinary equity financing.
